description: Presentations on Hardware and Lockpicking at DEF CON 23 covers physical security, embedded device exploitation, electronic safe bypassing, and hardware root-of-trust security.

talks.title: Teddy Reed and Nick Anderson - Hardware and Trust Security ELI5
talks.teaser: An approachable breakdown of hardware roots of trust, cryptographic coprocessors, and supply chain integrity in modern compute devices.

talks.title: Dan Petro and Oscar Salaza - Hacking Smart Safes: On the Brink of a Robbery
talks.teaser: Dan Petro and Oscar Salazar reverse engineer electronic smart safes, uncovering firmware vulnerabilities and remote lock bypasses.

talks.title: Mike Ryan and Richo Healey
talks.teaser: Exploiting unencrypted Bluetooth Low Energy protocols and radio links used by motorized electric skateboards to induce remote stops.

talks.title: AmmonRa - How to Hack Your Way out of Home Detention
talks.teaser: Analyzing the radio frequency signals, tamper sensors, and hardware limitations of electronic home detention and ankle monitoring bracelets.
